preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 500.
The number of edges m must be between 0 and the maximum possible number of edges for n vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Yes' if any(s for s in possible_strings if graph_from_string(s) == G) else 'No'
postconditions.description: Output 'Yes' if there exists a valid string s that produces the graph G, otherwise output 'No'.
If a valid string s exists, its length must be exactly n.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abc' for c in stdout.splitlines()[1])
postconditions.description: If a valid string s exists, it must consist only of the letters 'a', 'b', and 'c'.
